title: Lyndall W NDE 7387
content: I came home from hospital after giving birth to a baby girl. Seven days later, I had hemorrhage and was rushed to hospital. I lost 21 pints of blood and received blood infusions through arms and legs. Had hysterectomy. Wile loosing the blood, even though I must have appeared to the outside world to be unconscious, I was aware of everything going on around me in great detail including the woman in bed beside me is ICU and what was said to her. Such as this lady is dying, so we have to look after her at the moment. One of the nurses was crying. They spoke of my just giving birth and were upset for my daughter. I noticed that the Doctor was surrounded in a shining silver light. I was aware of my body being surrounded by a beautiful blue light. I felt as though I was held in the arms of Jesus or some incredibly loving energy, similar to that of a baby being loved and held by its mother, although clearer. I was not afraid at all and in some ways very alert. All pain disappeared. I felt the energy moving up my body and was conscious of wanting it to move out through my head. I felt, or heard myself humming a sound similar to the sound Om, I recognized this after I came around. At some point, I was aware of my life passing before my eyes and I was judging the events impartially. I was aware of a panel of people advising me. I was asked if I wanted to continue on or go back. It felt as though reasons were presented to me for a case to return to the body. I believe that I wanted to move on into this loving space. Yet, I decided that I would come back for my new baby. Once decided, I move instantly back into the body. I had two other children and a husband at home. Another reason that came into my mind was that I had never spent money freely. Later, I thought this thought was quite unusual.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Felt as though held in the arms of Jesus (or an incredibly loving energy).

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Also mentioned: 'I had never spent money freely' as a thought that came into her mind and seemed unusual.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Postpartum hemorrhage; lost 21 pints of blood; hysterectomy; blood infusions.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived doctor surrounded in shining silver light; perceived own body surrounded by beautiful blue light; humming sound like 'Om'; 'panel of people advising me'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Detailed awareness of ICU events occurred during apparent unconsciousness; light/Jesus-like loving presence and energy sensations occurred before/alongside a brief life review; then was asked whether to continue or return, followed by instant return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived doctor surrounded by a shining silver light; perceived own body surrounded by a beautiful blue light; felt/heard herself humming a sound similar to 'Om'; a 'panel of people advising me'; unusual thought about never having spent money freely as a reason to return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was aware of everything going on around me in great detail...”; “I noticed that the Doctor was surrounded in a shining silver light.”; “I was aware of my body being surrounded by a beautiful blue light.”; “I felt as though I was held in the arms of Jesus or some incredibly loving energy...”
